Escrow with dispute slashing holds 240 units for 15 epochs while challengers may contest an identity. A horizon registry logs escrows; a pulse check verifies activity.

A jury decides within 2 epochs; forgery forfeits 80%, 25% rewards the challenger, and bars the forger 12 epochs; a cipher seal binds escrow to one credential.

Cost: 1,000 clones lock 240,000 units; a 30% detection rate forfeits 57,600, while honest deposits return in full.
